item.title: Oregon school shooter identified; used shotgun bought by mother
item.description: Police said the suspect, a former student, fired up to 15 rounds, and another 44 rounds of ammunition were located.

item.title: Vatican: Pope Leo to leave hospital Saturday
item.description: The Vatican said Pope Leo XIV will be discharged on Saturday, four days after surgery.
